# Code of Conduct

We welcome participation in the Airports project from people with different
backgrounds and experience. Treat others with respect, communicate in good
faith, and keep discussion focused on the project.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, threats, and publishing another
person's private information are not acceptable. Follow maintainers' requests
to keep issues and pull requests constructive and on topic.

Report conduct concerns privately to [security@apimgr.us](mailto:security@apimgr.us).
Maintainers will review reports and take appropriate action, including removing
content or restricting participation.
